description: This file defines the User entity class within the OrangeHRM system, utilizing Doctrine ORM for mapping to a database table. It includes properties and methods related to user data, roles, and associations with other entities such as Employee and UserAuthProvider.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user within the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_user' database table, with attributes such as username, password, status, role, and related entities like Employee and UserAuthProvider.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the user.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the user.

methods.name: getUserName
methods.description: Returns the username.

methods.name: setUserName
methods.description: Sets the username.

methods.name: getUserPassword
methods.description: Returns the user's password.

methods.name: setUserPassword
methods.description: Sets the user's password.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Returns whether the user is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the user as deleted or not.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the user's active status.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the user's active status.

methods.name: getDateEntered
methods.description: Returns the date the user was entered into the system.

methods.name: setDateEntered
methods.description: Sets the date the user was entered into the system.

methods.name: getDateModified
methods.description: Returns the date the user data was last modified.

methods.name: setDateModified
methods.description: Sets the date the user data was last modified.

methods.name: getModifiedUserId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user who last modified this user.

methods.name: setModifiedUserId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the user who last modified this user.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user who created this user.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the ID of the user who created this user.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the associated Employee entity.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with this user.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this user.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Returns the UserRole associated with this user.

methods.name: setUserRole
methods.description: Assigns a UserRole to this user.

methods.name: getAuthProviders
methods.description: Returns the collection of authentication providers linked to this user.

methods.name: setAuthProviders
methods.description: Sets the collection of authentication providers for this user.
